svg.title: The forward map may fold
svg.desc: A monotone radial curve and a folded polynomial share a plotted domain. The horizontal target radius intersects the folded curve twice.
svg.text: Green: ρ = r(1−0.2r²) Brown: ρ = r−r³ Dashed: target radius 0.25
Horizontal axis: ideal radius. Vertical axis: distorted radius. A folded map has more than one possible preimage.
